status: PROPOSED — consumer (SCM) implemented and tested locally against a synthetic core; provider (apps/server scm-core-facade.js) being aligned to this revision; not integrator-reviewed

v1-draft.2: resolve-scope takes a Business selector: request body {businessId} (strict), forwarded from the BFF's x-zuri-business-id; the answer is the selected Business's Tenant and the grants of that Tenant's visible Businesses only
new resolve-scope refusals 404 BUSINESS_NOT_FOUND and 404 NO_VISIBLE_BUSINESS, both → SCM 404 SCM_SCOPE_NOT_FOUND (legacy body)
409 SCOPE_NOT_SINGLE_TENANT is removed (the selector makes every scope single-Tenant); 409 SCOPE_TOO_LARGE is kept
facts (branch, branches, customer, conversation) require the subject's COMMERCE view of the named Business on the provider side
the consumer may cache successful resolve-scope answers for a bounded TTL (consumerCache)

pattern: ADR-108 (market-core.v1): one private core façade, static service bearer, end-user credential forwarded opaquely; core is the only identity authority

provider.owner: Core (Identity) — resolve-scope, branch, branches, conversation; CRM — customer (served through the same core façade)
provider.network: private service network only; never exposed through the public ingress

consumer.config: SCM_AUTH_MODE=core, SCM_CORE_URL (http/https, no credentials/query/hash; in production https, or plain http only to a single-label service name such as http://web:3000), SCM_CORE_TOKEN (>= 32 chars, differs from SCM_API_TOKEN), SCM_CORE_TIMEOUT_MS (default 3000), SCM_CORE_SCOPE_CACHE_TTL_MS (default 15000, max 60000, 0 = off), SCM_CORE_SCOPE_CACHE_MAX_ENTRIES (default 1000, max 100000)

auth.service: Authorization: Bearer <SCM_CORE_TOKEN> — authenticates the SCM service; confers no business authority
auth.subject: x-zuri-subject: <end user's session credential>, exactly as the BFF received it (1..4096 chars); core resolves it on EVERY call; SCM never parses, logs or stores it; the only thing derived from it that SCM keeps beyond one request is a successful resolve-scope answer, for at most the cache TTL (consumerCache)
auth.businessSelector: resolve-scope body `businessId` = the user's active Business, forwarded unchanged from the BFF's x-zuri-business-id (1..200 chars, no control characters, not whitespace-only; SCM refuses anything else with 400 SCM_BUSINESS_SELECTOR_REQUIRED before calling core). A SELECTOR, never an authority: core decides visibility from the subject alone

coreRefusals.401 {error:{code:'SUBJECT_UNAUTHENTICATE: the subject is missing, expired, revoked or unknown → SCM answers its caller 401 SCM_SUBJECT_UNAUTHENTICATED (retryable:false)
coreRefusals.401 {error:{code:'SERVICE_TOKEN_INVALID': the SCM service token is wrong → SCM answers 502 SCM_CORE_REJECTED (retryable:false)
coreRefusals.404 {error:{code:'BUSINESS_NOT_FOUND'}}: the subject cannot see the selected Business, or it does not exist / is deleted — core does not disclose which → SCM answers 404 SCM_SCOPE_NOT_FOUND, message 'Business not found', retryable:false (the legacy non-enumeration body, identical to scm-api.v1.json auth.scopeDenial)
coreRefusals.404 {error:{code:'NO_VISIBLE_BUSINESS'}}: the subject sees no Business at all → the same SCM 404 SCM_SCOPE_NOT_FOUND
coreRefusals.409 {error:{code:'SCOPE_TOO_LARGE'}} (re: more than 500 visible Businesses in the selected Tenant → 502 SCM_CORE_REJECTED (retryable:false)

removed.409 SCOPE_NOT_SINGLE_TENANT: removed in v1-draft.2 — the selector makes every scope single-Tenant; a 409 of any code is still 502 SCM_CORE_REJECTED

transport.method: POST for every operation; request body application/json; response application/json
transport.envelope: { "contractVersion": "scm-core.v1", "ok": true, "data": <operation data> } — any other envelope, version, extra field in data, wrong type or bound violation is RESPONSE_INVALID
transport.retries: every operation is an idempotent read: one retry by default with jittered backoff (backoffMs * attempt * (0.5 + random)); never for 401/403/404/4xx and never for RESPONSE_TOO_LARGE

consumerErrors.503 SCM_CORE_UNAVAILABLE: retryable:true, no effect — reason (internal, not echoed): NETWORK | TIMEOUT | HTTP_5xx | RESPONSE_INVALID | RESPONSE_TOO_LARGE; a fact failure carries details.reference
consumerErrors.502 SCM_CORE_REJECTED: retryable:false, no effect — the service itself was refused
consumerErrors.404 SCM_SCOPE_NOT_FOUND: retryable:false — core's BUSINESS_NOT_FOUND / NO_VISIBLE_BUSINESS; body identical to the delegation path's denied()
consumerErrors.401 SCM_SUBJECT_UNAUTHENTICATED: retryable:false — the user must sign in again
consumerErrors.401 SCM_SUBJECT_REQUIRED: retryable:false — raised by SCM before core is called
consumerErrors.400 SCM_BUSINESS_SELECTOR_REQUIRED: retryable:false — raised by SCM before core is called (after the subject check)

consumerCache.what: successful resolve-scope answers only ({actorId, tenantId, grants}); never a refusal (401/403/404/409), an error or an outage; never a fact
consumerCache.key: sha256 over the JSON array ['scm-scope-cache.v1', sha256(SCM_CORE_TOKEN), subject, businessId] — the raw subject is never a key, never stored and never logged, and the cached value holds no subject
consumerCache.perRequest: every request, hit or miss, gets a fresh frozen scope with its own delegationId and its own subject binding for the fact calls
consumerCache.tradeoff: a session revoked, or a grant changed, in core can keep acting in SCM for up to the TTL

disclosure: Core re-resolves the subject and checks that the subject holds the COMMERCE view of the named Business (the legacy POS / sales-order gate) BEFORE answering a fact. A fact for a Business the subject has no commerce view of, of another Tenant, or that does not exist is { "fact": null } (branches: an empty list) — never 403/404, so existence is not disclosed (the same non-enumeration rule as scm-api.v1.json auth.scopeDenial). SCM still applies its own legacy predicate to every non-null fact (tenant, Business, status, deletedAt) inside its unit of work.
consistency: Facts are read BEFORE the SCM unit of work opens; a reference revoked between the read and the commit is not seen (bounded by the request deadline; the outcome reports references.verifiedAt and references.authority='core'). Scope may additionally be up to the consumer cache TTL old.

operations.name: resolve-scope

request.businessId: string 1..200 — the selected Business (strict: no other field)

response.tenantId: string 1..200 — the Tenant of the selected Business

operations.bounds: at most 500 Businesses (else 409 SCOPE_TOO_LARGE); strict (unknown fields rejected); one grant per Business the subject can see (any domain) IN THE SELECTED BUSINESS'S TENANT ONLY — a grant's presence is SCM's `visible(businessId)`; the selected Business is always included (SCM treats a scope without it as RESPONSE_INVALID)
operations.refusals: 404 NO_VISIBLE_BUSINESS (the subject sees no Business); 404 BUSINESS_NOT_FOUND (the selected Business is not visible, unknown or deleted); 409 SCOPE_TOO_LARGE
operations.notes: SCM builds the same frozen scope the delegation path builds (scopeFromGrants); a Business with no grant is SCM's 404 SCM_SCOPE_NOT_FOUND

operations.name: branch
operations.nullWhen: no such Branch, another Tenant, or the subject has no commerce view of businessId

operations.name: branches
operations.bounds: at most 1000 rows; every Branch of that Business in any status (SCM filters ACTIVE and sorts)
operations.emptyWhen: the subject has no commerce view of businessId

operations.name: customer
operations.nullWhen: no such Customer, another Tenant, or the subject has no commerce view of businessId; a Customer homed in a Business the subject cannot see MAY be returned — SCM refuses it itself (CUSTOMER_NOT_FOUND)

operations.name: conversation
operations.nullWhen: no such Conversation, another Tenant, or the subject has no commerce view of businessId

notInThisContract.fileAsset: gate SCM-FILES — a separate Files façade; in core mode SCM keeps refusing slip references with 503 SCM_REFERENCE_AUTHORITY_UNAVAILABLE

delegationFallback: scm.delegation.v1 (HMAC) remains for tests / non-production only (SCM_AUTH_MODE=delegation) until removed; production refuses it at start
